bullets: Added a safety check that blocks the assistant from deleting critical personal folders like Home, Documents, and Downloads.
Renamed the Freebuff streak reward from daily credits to points that unlock appearance themes.
Limited-access accounts now earn one-tenth of the standard point amounts from their streak days.
Enabled web-based cloud chats to restart after hitting CPU limits instead of ending permanently.
Fixed a bug where copying older projects into the cloud lost their data backend connection details.
Updated the public data-use FAQ to clarify that some features collect data for AI training and ad sharing.
Renamed the middle reasoning effort label from Medium to Balanced in the model picker.
Removed the Earn section from the settings menu and search index.
Required advertisers signing up on or after November 27, 2026, to verify conversion tracking for the $500 credit.
Added a specific message to chat transcripts that appears when a task resumes after a device reconnects.
Defined a filter that allows template previews on specific Freebuff domains to embed directly in the workspace.
